activity.notes: Khosrow II regained the Sasanian throne in 591 with Roman support and ruled until his deposition and death in 628. This second reign is intentionally separate from his brief 590 first reign because Bahrām Chōbin's usurpation was a real interruption.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica — Byzantine-Iranian Relations
sources.citation_text: Encyclopaedia Iranica explicitly lists Khosrow II Parvēz as reigning in 590 and again from 591 to 628.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica — Chronology of Iranian History, Part 1
sources.citation_text: Iranica records Khosrow II's restoration in 591 and his deposition and execution in 628.
